payload.reason: The evidence indicates that while there are advancements in end-to-end neural models, many industrial dialogue systems still rely on rule-based approaches and handcrafted features, suggesting they do not primarily use off-the-shelf NLP systems.

claims.text: Many industrially deployed dialogue systems still use manual features or handcrafted rules instead of off-the-shelf NLP systems.
End-to-end approaches, despite their advantages, are not yet suitable for commercial conversational agents operating on real-world data.
